title: Ask should promote repeated AI VBG BE readiness questions into answer memory
problemStatement: 用户会反复问同一个持续状态问题，但表达不同：第一次短问“那个 BE ready 了吗”，第二次问“AI VBG 的 BE 部分完成情况如何”，第三次再回到短问。系统应在底层记录 observation、promote thread、后续命中 prior，同时答案仍由本次 evidence 支撑。
expectedExtraction: Extract current surface=RingCentral, chat title=MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG, project=AI VBG, role=BE/backend/后端, intent=status/readiness/completion.
expectedBehavior: The same canonical topic should be stable across deictic and explicit phrasings. Prior reuse must not replace current recall; the final answer still needs evidence.

sampleContext.primaryText: Recent read-only memory sampling showed MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG activity, context frames for backend/BE, and evidence mentioning RCV BE new design.
secondaryTexts: This eval intentionally repeats the same durable status need with different phrasing.
The expected diagnostic states are observed -> promoted -> priorHit.
